n9eebdb51bf.headline: Morning Bid: The final Fed countdown
n9eebdb51bf.summary: Reuters' Morning Bid says the Federal Reserve meeting on Wednesday is fast approaching and is a key focus for U.S. and global markets.
n9eebdb51bf.why: The Federal Reserve sets U.S. interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, the dollar and asset prices worldwide.

nc3800f6f32.headline: Banking sector steadies as Cyprus eyes a more resilient future
nc3800f6f32.summary: Cyprus's banks are entering a new chapter shaped by consolidation and rising profitability. Household debt, housing affordability and governance reform remain pressures.
nc3800f6f32.why: Banks are central to lending and deposits in Cyprus, and their health affects credit conditions for households and businesses.

n6d1e4b4907.headline: Trump says 'We'll see' on whether to restart trade talks with Canada
n6d1e4b4907.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said 'we'll see' when asked whether he would resume trade talks with Canada that he halted earlier this year. He commented further on the ongoing trade dispute.
n6d1e4b4907.why: Canada and the United States are each other's largest trading partners, so tariff and trade disputes affect exporters and currencies on both sides.

ne894445f38.headline: Hiring slowing as costs, minimum wage increase
ne894445f38.summary: Hiring in Hawaii is slowing as costs and a minimum wage increase weigh on employers, according to the Hawaii Tribune-Herald.
ne894445f38.why: Hiring trends and wage rules shape labour costs and employment, which feed into consumer spending and local economic growth.

n504cd515a8.headline: Cyprus GDP growth outperforms EU average with robust quarterly rise
n504cd515a8.summary: Cyprus recorded seasonally adjusted GDP growth of 0.9% in the third quarter of 2025 versus the previous quarter, following 0.7% growth in the second quarter, according to Eurostat.
n504cd515a8.why: Eurostat quarterly GDP data is the standard measure of euro-area growth. Strong growth in a small economy like Cyprus can affect sovereign credit and investor sentiment in the region.

n9ae84e5be7.headline: BNP Paribas Raises Stake in Belgium's Largest Insurer Ageas in Deal Worth $3.5 Billion
n9ae84e5be7.summary: BNP Paribas plans to increase its stake in Belgium's largest insurer Ageas to 22.5% from 14.9%, as part of a two-leg transaction worth $3.5 billion.
n9ae84e5be7.why: Ageas is a major Belgian insurer listed in Brussels, and BNP Paribas is a large French bank. Large anchor-investor stakes can affect shareholder structure and future corporate control.

impacts.name: Ageas
impacts.why: BNP Paribas's increased stake makes it a larger anchor shareholder in Ageas.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n6bc57aac6d.headline: Amazon pays €180m to settle tax and labour probe in Italy
n6bc57aac6d.summary: Amazon's Italian unit has agreed to pay €180m to settle a tax and labour probe. The case centred on allegations from July 2024 that the unit bypassed labour and tax obligations.
n6bc57aac6d.why: Amazon is the world's largest online retailer, and tax and labour disputes in major European markets can affect its costs and regulatory exposure.

n9db1067c0f.headline: Argentina To Let Banks Offer Bitcoin And Crypto Services
n9db1067c0f.summary: The Banco Central de la República Argentina is reportedly drafting rules that would let commercial banks offer bitcoin and crypto services. The plan has not been finalised.
n9db1067c0f.why: The central bank regulates Argentina's banking system, and rules permitting banks to offer crypto products would expand institutional access to digital assets.

n8120001879.headline: UK Grid Operator Scraps 300 GW of Zombie Energy Projects
n8120001879.summary: The UK's National Energy System Operator has reformed its grid connection process, cancelling over 300 GW of stalled projects. Viable green energy developments are being fast-tracked.
n8120001879.why: Grid connection queues determine which generation and storage projects can reach the network, which shapes the investment pipeline for UK renewables.

nfc99d49cd3.headline: South Africa's SPAR full-year profit falls on higher finance costs, tax rate
nfc99d49cd3.summary: South African supermarket retailer SPAR Group reported a decline in full-year profit. Higher financing costs and a higher effective tax rate weighed on earnings despite improved trading elements.
nfc99d49cd3.why: SPAR is a major South African grocery retailer, and its profit depends on sales volumes, financing costs and tax.

nfcf3b5f2bf.headline: Oil falls 2% as Iraqi oilfield production restored, Ukraine talks continue
nfcf3b5f2bf.summary: Oil prices slipped 2% after Iraq restored production at an oilfield accounting for 0.5% of world supply. Brent crude futures were down $1.26 at $62.49 a barrel.
nfcf3b5f2bf.why: Brent is the global benchmark for crude oil, and changes in supply from major producers like Iraq affect fuel prices and energy markets.
nfcf3b5f2bf.why_moved: Iraq restored production at an oilfield representing 0.5% of world supply, while investors weighed Ukraine peace talks, per the article.

n8ee48fc200.headline: Speaker Johnson Releases NDAA to Help Trump's 'Peace Through Strength Agenda'
n8ee48fc200.summary: The final text of the National Defense Authorization Act for fiscal 2026 was released Sunday evening. The bill is part of the Trump administration's peace-through-strength agenda.
n8ee48fc200.why: The NDAA sets US defence spending and procurement priorities, which affect defence contractors and government budgets.

n62747ab8ad.headline: India’s GDP Beats Forecasts In Q2 FY26 Driven By Strong Consumption And Capital Formation
n62747ab8ad.summary: India's economy outperformed expectations in Q2 FY26, with private consumption expenditure accelerating to 7.9 per cent, supported by tax cuts, GST rationalisation and easing inflation.
n62747ab8ad.why: India is one of the world's fastest-growing large economies, so its quarterly GDP data shapes views on emerging-market equities, the rupee and central bank policy.

n639ae1f9a6.headline: Telecom Retirees and Health Workers Rally Across Iranian Cities Amidst Deepening Economic Crisis
n639ae1f9a6.summary: Protests were reported across Iranian cities on December 8, 2025, including by telecom retirees and health workers, amid a deepening economic crisis.
n639ae1f9a6.why: Iran's economic strains and unrest affect oil export prospects, sanctions exposure and regional risk premia.

nfbc6948ad9.headline: Protesting farmers disrupt airport flights in Crete
nfbc6948ad9.summary: Greek farmers demanding payment of EU subsidies shut the two main international airports on Crete on Monday. The protest followed clashes with riot police.
nfbc6948ad9.why: Crete is a major tourism hub, and disruption at its airports affects travel flows and the island's economy.

n6d829d2779.headline: A year after his triumph, UK PM Keir Starmer faces the mirror: What went wrong and what comes next
n6d829d2779.summary: A year after a commanding election victory, Prime Minister Keir Starmer faces significant challenges, including a budget leak and voter dissatisfaction. The report outlines what went wrong and what comes next.
n6d829d2779.why: Political stability and fiscal credibility in the UK influence gilt yields and sterling.

n0e88ab8f98.headline: Binance Bags Three Licenses: Becomes The First To Secure Global License Under ADGM
n0e88ab8f98.summary: Binance secured three licences from the Financial Services Regulatory Authority in Abu Dhabi Global Market, becoming the first crypto exchange to obtain a global licence under the framework.
n0e88ab8f98.why: Binance is the largest crypto exchange, and regulatory licences determine where it can legally serve clients and how it operates.

n8a66b48748.headline: China’s exports to U.S. extend double-digit declines, dropping 29% in November, despite trade truce
n8a66b48748.summary: China's exports to the United States fell 29% in November, extending an eighth straight monthly decline, while overall exports rose 5.9% from a year earlier, beating expectations.
n8a66b48748.why: China is the world's largest exporter, and its trade with the United States is a key gauge of US-China trade tensions and global demand.

n582be2afe8.headline: Unilever Completes Ice Cream Demerger As Magnum Ice Cream Company Begins Trading
n582be2afe8.summary: Unilever has completed the demerger of its ice cream division, which now operates as The Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V., with its shares trading in Amsterdam, London and New York.
n582be2afe8.why: Unilever is a global consumer goods group, and the demerger separates its ice cream business into a standalone listed company.

n26ff911347.headline: Supreme Court seems likely to back Trump's power to fire independent agency board members
n26ff911347.summary: The Supreme Court seemed likely on Monday to expand presidential control over independent federal agencies. The conservative majority suggested it would overturn a 90-year-old precedent limiting such firings.
n26ff911347.why: Independent agency boards oversee regulators such as financial and trade bodies, so changes to their independence affect regulatory policy for investors.

nc6c7ddc519.headline: MicroBT Launches WhatsMiner M70 In Abu Dhabi, Pushing For Sustainable Bitcoin Mining
nc6c7ddc519.summary: MicroBT launched its energy-efficient WhatsMiner M70 series in Abu Dhabi, highlighting sustainable mining strategies. The launch targets the bitcoin mining industry.
nc6c7ddc519.why: MicroBT is a bitcoin mining hardware maker, and mining efficiency affects the economics of bitcoin production.

nda6d32e3b5.headline: A Paramount Play For WBD Seeks To Trump Netflix
nda6d32e3b5.summary: Paramount is launching an all-cash tender offer for all Warner Bros. Discovery shares, challenging Netflix's proposed $72 billion takeover of Warner Bros. The offer values the company at $30 per share.
nda6d32e3b5.why: Warner Bros. Discovery owns HBO and major studios, and competing bids for it shape the future structure of the global media industry.

impacts.name: Netflix
impacts.why: Netflix's proposed takeover of Warner Bros. is being countered by Paramount's offer.

nca26387188.headline: الريال الإيراني يسجل أدنى سعر تاريخي
nca26387188.summary: Iranian media reported that the Iranian rial fell on Monday to its lowest level on record. The report gave no further detail in the available text.
nca26387188.why: The rial is Iran's national currency, and its value reflects the country's sanctions pressure and inflation. Currency weakness affects import costs and the purchasing power of Iranian households.
nca26387188.why_moved: Iranian media reported the currency dropped to a new historic low on Monday. The input gives no specific cause.

nc4fc8d25bd.headline: UAE Official Hails Bitcoin As ‘Key Pillar In Future Finance’
nc4fc8d25bd.summary: UAE official Mohammed Al Shamsi described the nation's Bitcoin adoption as a key part of a historical phase reshaping the global financial system. He spoke at the Bitcoin MENA conference.
nc4fc8d25bd.why: The United Arab Emirates has built a regulated digital-asset framework and seeks to be a hub for crypto businesses. Government statements on Bitcoin can signal the direction of crypto policy.

nd6b110479c.headline: بيان سعودي قطري: توقيع اتفاقية الربط بالقطار الكهربائي السريع بين البلدين
nd6b110479c.summary: A joint Saudi-Qatari statement issued at the close of Qatar's emir's visit to the kingdom announced signing of a high-speed electric rail link agreement between the two countries.
nd6b110479c.why: Saudi Arabia and Qatar are Gulf neighbours pursuing economic integration and infrastructure investment. Cross-border rail projects create construction and logistics opportunities for contractors and suppliers.

n406d6dd526.headline: The Leaked Report Pushing Mark Carney Toward the F-35 Fighter Jet
n406d6dd526.summary: A leaked internal study is reported to be shaping the multi-billion-dollar debate over Canada's air force, with the report pushing Prime Minister Mark Carney toward the F-35 fighter jet.
n406d6dd526.why: Large defence procurement contracts affect government spending, aerospace suppliers and the domestic industrial base.

n267e045bbb.headline: Central bank rates outlook may pivot on wages, labour
n267e045bbb.summary: A major bank analysed about 400,000 accounts and found an uptick in wages. The finding may pivot the central bank rates outlook, according to the report.
n267e045bbb.why: Wage growth feeds into inflation, which influences central bank decisions on interest rates.

n58e1567a2d.headline: 'Difficult decision' on energy bill relief payments
n58e1567a2d.summary: Australian households and businesses will not receive further energy bill relief, following a government decision, according to the report.
n58e1567a2d.why: Energy bill subsidies affect household spending power and business operating costs, which feed into Australian inflation and growth.

n9f41b80b95.headline: Ola Electric Stock Tanks 80 Per Cent From Peak, Market Cap Falls Below ₹15,000 Crore
n9f41b80b95.summary: Ola Electric shares have fallen nearly 80% from their post-listing peak, extending losses for a seventh straight session and pushing market value below ₹15,000 crore.
n9f41b80b95.why: Ola Electric is an Indian electric two-wheeler maker, and its share price reflects investor views on its growth, guidance and profitability.
n9f41b80b95.why_moved: Heavy selling, weak guidance and technical breakdowns have pushed the stock far below its IPO price, raising investor concerns.

nc532164133.headline: Satellite Startup ICEYE Raises Funds at $2.8 Billion Valuation as Europe Boosts Defense
nc532164133.summary: ICEYE, a Finnish satellite developer with defense contracts, raised funds at a €2.4 billion ($2.8 billion) valuation as Europe boosts defense spending.
nc532164133.why: ICEYE builds radar earth-observation satellites used in defense and commercial markets, and European defense budgets are a key demand driver.

n91bbee2895.headline: Bessent divested from soybean farms after ethics office warning
n91bbee2895.summary: Bessent divested from soybean farms after a warning from an ethics office, according to a report published by the Hawaii Tribune-Herald.
n91bbee2895.why: Scott Bessent is the US Treasury Secretary, so conflict-of-interest questions about his asset holdings bear on the credibility of Treasury policy.

nd4b79cf741.headline: Japanese purchases of U.K. gilts at highest since 2021 in October
nd4b79cf741.summary: Japanese investors bought a net ¥418.6 billion of UK government debt in October, the most since January 2021, according to balance-of-payments data.
nd4b79cf741.why: Japan is one of the largest foreign holders of government bonds, so its purchases of gilts affect demand for UK debt.

n7a9dd1d91d.headline: German firms not in first batch of China
n7a9dd1d91d.summary: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul says talks with China on rare earth export licences are progressing, but German firms are missing from the first batch.
n7a9dd1d91d.why: Rare earth export licences from China affect supply for manufacturers in semiconductors, autos and other high-tech industries.

nf7715404d3.headline: Havila to Appeal Oslo Court Decision
nf7715404d3.summary: Havila Shipping said its case was not upheld in Oslo District Court and that it will appeal the judgment. The company referenced earlier actions in January and March.
nf7715404d3.why: Havila Shipping is a Norwegian coastal and offshore vessel operator, so court outcomes can affect its finances and operations.

n371a483505.headline: Borr Drilling Limited Announces Public Offering of Common Shares
n371a483505.summary: Borr Drilling Limited plans to raise approximately $85 million in gross proceeds through a public offering of common shares, according to a company announcement.
n371a483505.why: Borr Drilling is an offshore drilling contractor serving oil and gas producers, so its capital raising reflects demand for offshore rig services.

n84e68386d6.headline: Japan revises data to show bigger Q3 economic contraction
n84e68386d6.summary: Japan's economy contracted faster than initially estimated in the third quarter, the government reported Monday. Exports suffered.
n84e68386d6.why: Japan is the world's fourth-largest economy, and its quarterly GDP data guides central bank policy and the Nikkei 225 outlook.

n12d6eb113b.headline: Bank of Canada expected to hold key rate, move to sidelines after an uncertain 2025
n12d6eb113b.summary: Economists widely expect the Bank of Canada to hold its 2.25 per cent policy rate at its final decision of the year on Wednesday. The bank is expected to then move to the sidelines.
n12d6eb113b.why: The Bank of Canada sets the country's benchmark policy rate, which influences borrowing costs, government bond yields and the Canadian dollar.

n71027bbfa6.headline: Stocks, bonds cautiously hopeful Fed will deliver
n71027bbfa6.summary: Share and bond markets were guardedly optimistic on Monday that the Federal Reserve would deliver a much-needed rate cut at a meeting this week, which looks set to be one of the most closely watched.
n71027bbfa6.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, bond yields and equity valuations worldwide.
n71027bbfa6.why_moved: Markets are cautiously hopeful the Federal Reserve will cut rates this week. The input does not confirm the decision itself.

n86948240f0.headline: AsymBio Commences Commercial Operations at Fengxian Base, Strengthening Global Biopharmaceutical CDMO Capabilities
n86948240f0.summary: AsymBio, a subsidiary of Asymchem Group, has commenced commercial operations at its Fengxian base, strengthening its global contract development and manufacturing capabilities, according to a press release.
n86948240f0.why: Contract development and manufacturing organisations (CDMOs) make drugs for pharmaceutical companies, and new capacity expands their output and revenue potential.

n3a9fc46199.headline: South Korea Pushes No-Fault Liability After Upbit Hack
n3a9fc46199.summary: South Korea plans no-fault liability for crypto exchanges, requiring compensation without proof of negligence. The plan follows a $28 million hack of the Upbit exchange.
n3a9fc46199.why: Upbit is one of South Korea's largest cryptocurrency exchanges. Rules on exchange liability affect operating costs and risk for crypto platforms and their customers.

nce014cae03.headline: Paramount rivals Netflix with $108.4bn Warner Bros bid
nce014cae03.summary: Paramount Skydance has launched a hostile bid for Warner Bros Discovery worth $108.4 billion. The offer disrupts Warner Bros Discovery's agreed deal with Netflix.
nce014cae03.why: Warner Bros Discovery owns major film, television and streaming assets, and Netflix is the leading global streaming service. Hostile bids can reshape media consolidation and deal terms for both companies.

impacts.name: Netflix
impacts.why: The bid disrupts the existing Warner Bros Discovery deal agreed with Netflix.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nce014cae03.why_moved: A hostile bid valued at $108.4 billion is directly aimed at Warner Bros Discovery and challenges its pending deal with Netflix, so investors are repricing both companies.

n75d59a1059.headline: Trump greenlights exports of Nvidia H200 chips to China
n75d59a1059.summary: President Donald Trump announced on Monday that exports of Nvidia H200 chips to China have been greenlit. The decision concerns advanced AI semiconductor sales to China.
n75d59a1059.why: Nvidia designs graphics processors widely used for artificial intelligence, and China is a large market for its chips. U.S. export rules on advanced chips directly affect revenue from that market.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Permission to export H200 chips to China opens sales of Nvidia's products into that market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n75d59a1059.why_moved: The announcement permits exports of Nvidia H200 chips to China, which opens a major market for the company's AI processors.

n70561847e9.headline: BNPB estimates Sumatra flood recovery cost at US$3.1 billion
n70561847e9.summary: Indonesia's National Disaster Mitigation Agency estimated the total recovery cost for northern Sumatra regions hit by major floods at US$3.1 billion. The estimate covers reconstruction after the disaster.
n70561847e9.why: Large disaster recovery spending affects public budgets, construction demand and insurance losses in the affected region. It is a key input for assessing Indonesia's fiscal position.

n985514e82a.headline: MPTC eyeing more projects in Vietnam
n985514e82a.summary: Metro Pacific Tollways Corp. is open to investing more in Vietnam if opportunities arise. Vietnam is becoming more aggressive on road construction to ease traffic congestion.
n985514e82a.why: Metro Pacific Tollways is a Philippine toll road operator with infrastructure assets in Southeast Asia. Expansion into new toll projects affects its long-term revenue base.

na3902db9fd.headline: CLI raises P4 billion from bond issuance
na3902db9fd.summary: Cebu Landmasters Inc. raised P4 billion from a sustainability-linked bond offering that was oversubscribed. The company said the deal supports its growth pipeline.
na3902db9fd.why: Cebu Landmasters is a property developer in the Visayas and Mindanao regions of the Philippines. Bond issuance indicates how local developers fund expansion and how investors view their credit.

n1023f4a4d3.headline: GoTyme Bank Launches Crypto Trading in the Philippines in Partnership with Alpaca
n1023f4a4d3.summary: GoTyme Bank, a joint venture between the Gokongwei Group and Tyme Group, announced the launch of crypto trading in the Philippines. The service is built in partnership with Alpaca.
n1023f4a4d3.why: GoTyme is a digital bank in the Philippines, and bringing crypto trading to its customers expands retail access to digital assets. Partnerships with brokerage infrastructure providers are a common route for banks entering this space.

nbbddf4aff1.headline: Pertamina-Rosneft Tuban Refinery decision expected mid-December: govt
nbbddf4aff1.summary: Indonesia's Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia said a decision on whether Pertamina and Russia's Rosneft will proceed with the Tuban refinery is expected mid-December.
nbbddf4aff1.why: Pertamina is Indonesia's state-owned oil company, and Rosneft is Russia's largest oil producer. Refinery projects affect fuel supply and capacity in Southeast Asia.

n8aab021465.headline: Trump announces a $12B aid package for farmers hit hard by his trade war
n8aab021465.summary: President Donald Trump is planning a $12 billion farm aid package for farmers hurt by his trade war, according to a White House official. The package is designed to offset trade-related losses.
n8aab021465.why: Farm aid packages are government transfers that cushion agricultural producers from export losses and price shocks. They affect farm incomes, crop markets and trade policy debates.

nc045b3c8a3.headline: Horror in Japan as 3m Tsunami Warning Follows 7.6-Magnitude Quake: 90,000 Forced to Evacuate Homes
nc045b3c8a3.summary: A 7.6-magnitude earthquake struck northeastern Japan, triggering tsunami warnings of up to 3 metres. Authorities evacuated thousands of residents while assessing damage and injuries.
nc045b3c8a3.why: Northeastern Japan hosts major industrial and manufacturing facilities, and large quakes can disrupt production, logistics and supply chains. Investors watch such events for damage to infrastructure and corporate operations.

n8af6fca8ea.headline: Down 51.9% YTD, Is Lululemon Stock a Buy Ahead of December 11?
n8af6fca8ea.summary: Lululemon stock has lost significant value year-to-date and is gaining positive momentum ahead of its third-quarter earnings report on December 11.
n8af6fca8ea.why: Lululemon is a athletic apparel retailer headquartered in Vancouver, and its quarterly results are closely watched for signs of demand in its core markets.

ne057acbdd0.headline: US dollar firms on expectations of limited Fed easing
ne057acbdd0.summary: The U.S. dollar rose against major currencies in choppy trading ahead of a week of central bank meetings headlined by the Federal Reserve. A rate cut is all but priced in, but investors expect a milder easing cycle than previously anticipated.
ne057acbdd0.why: The dollar is the world's main reserve and funding currency, so shifts in expected Federal Reserve policy affect global currency, bond and equity markets.
ne057acbdd0.why_moved: The dollar rose as traders priced in a Federal Reserve rate cut while bracing for signals of a smaller easing cycle than expected.

nc8cd624956.headline: 40% of Canadian Crypto Users Flagged for Tax Evasion Risk, Canadian Tax Authority Reveals
nc8cd624956.summary: Canada's tax agency says 40% of crypto users are flagged for tax evasion risk. It says legal gaps limit its ability to track crypto-related income, and it has recovered $100 million through audits.
nc8cd624956.why: Crypto tax enforcement and regulation affect how exchanges, investors and the wider digital asset market operate in Canada.

n94b8216e9b.headline: They Donated Bitcoin To Canadian Truckers – Then The Government Tried To Seize It All
n94b8216e9b.summary: Nunchuk wallet users distributed millions of dollars in bitcoin donations to Canadian truckers before police arrived. Only 0.28 BTC was ever frozen, according to Bitcoin Magazine.
n94b8216e9b.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value, and government actions against crypto holdings bear on regulatory risk across the sector.
